{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fynock''' was the designation of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Industries]]' high-end [[Starship/Legends|starship]] booster system, produced during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was built upon the designs of the [[Mynock/Legends|Mynock]] and [[Vynock/Legends|Vynock]] series of boosters, and was available in standard and deluxe versions, depending on the desired power output characteristics.
